privacy: Each moment holds only the viewer's PlayerView (public projection + own private view), selectors computed from it and projected public events. Checked against the authoritative hidden state at generation time.

moments.description: The viewer owns a Workshop Tech, so they have added the second Form & Decorate space; they have not yet added the second Glaze & Load space. Placement options, quotes and the Commission / Guild / Magistrate option lists are for this exact state.

error.message: Not enough coins: you need 4 and have 0.
Not enough coins: you need 3 and have 0.
Not enough clay: you need 1 and have 0.
Not enough clay: you need 2 and have 0.
Not enough clay: you need 3 and have 0.
Not enough coins: you need 1 and have 0.

moments.title: 3P · Round 2 · Work Phase · your turn (before action)

moments.description: The viewer's Shifu reserved a face-up Order (its display position is null until the viewer's turn ends — market.refillPendingFor is the viewer), gained a resource, then chose 'look at the top 3'. own.pendingLook holds the 3 Orders; other players only see counts.pendingLook (kind + count).

steered.why: Shifu to the Commission Market: first reservation face up (its slot stays empty until the turn ends).
Second reservation: look at the top 3 (private).

moments.title: 4P · Round 3 · Commission Market · Shifu mid-action with private top-3 look

moments.description: Kiln Die and Base Heat after the revealed Contributions are known; the Fire card is not yet revealed. Face-down Heat markers have no value yet (the viewer turns or returns theirs now). heatPreviews show Actual Heat before Fire and Quality per possible Fire card, null while a face-down marker is still undecided.
moments.title: 3P · Firing · Heat-marker step (step 5)

moments.description: Quality has been assigned. The viewer chooses after-Quality abilities in their own order (Ge Crackle, Protective Saggars, Second Firing), rechecked after each use. heatLadder.chips carries each ceramic's Actual Heat, Heat Difference and Quality.
moments.title: 3P · Firing · after-Quality window (step 10)

moments.description: In a 2-player game the Shared Kiln has 4 active spaces (High 2, Middle 1, Low 1); covered spaces are active:false in boardView.kilnSpaces. The Magistrate's Hall has capacity 1 (kilnLayout.centralCapacities).

error.message: Not enough coins: you need 4 and have 2.
Not enough coins: you need 3 and have 2.

moments.title: 2P · Work Phase · 2-1-1 Shared Kiln and 1-space Magistrate's Hall

moments.description: Only held Orders can be completed, in one First-Player-order pass. completableOrders gives one entry per completable held Order (its first match); orderMatchOptions lists every distinct ceramic group with the Crackle declarations that would be recorded; crackleDeclarationChecks run the validator's matcher (orderSelectionCheck) for each Decoration a Crackle ceramic could declare, so a declaration picker never re-implements Order rules.

error.message: These Crackle declarations do not satisfy the Order; others would.
The chosen ceramics do not meet Order O48 (wrong_count).

moments.title: 3P · Order Phase · completable held Orders with Crackle wildcard

moments.description: Cleanup step 2 (Rounds 1–4 only): the viewer holds more than the limit (4, or 5 with Colour Samples) and must discard exactly the excess. The prompt is parallel; other players' hands stay hidden (only counts).
moments.title: 3P · Cleanup · trim Orders to the hand limit

moments.description: FinalResult with each player's breakdown: orders, kilnAbilities, recognitionOverflow, imperialAudience, techs (recorded when gained, A1 — never added again at game end), exhibition (quality VP + Shape/Glaze diversity bonuses), connoisseur, coins, total; standings with tie-break values (Recognition, printed Crowns, Masterpieces) and resolvedBy.
moments.title: 3P · Final results

moments.description: Contributions are chosen secretly and simultaneously. phase.submittedPlayerIds shows who has submitted, never what; the viewer's own choice is not yet sealed. contributionOptions lists Tend / Bank / Stoke (and Fuel Ledger variants when owned) with Wood cost and affordability.

steered.why: Apprentice buys T21 so the step-1 fixture can show Fuel Ledger, Inverted Firing or Setter's Mark.
Apprentice buys T12 so the step-1 fixture can show Fuel Ledger, Inverted Firing or Setter's Mark.

components.note: 制坯饰纹、施釉装窑各有第二工位，习得相应门类技艺后添设（D7）。界面与文字不说“锁”“封”。

components.en: add (a second space, by learning a Tech)
components.note: 未有时写“习得坯作技艺即添此工位”（施釉装窑写“习得釉作技艺即添此工位”）；已有时写“由「⟨技艺⟩」添设”。
实体原型盖住尚未添设的第二工位；数字版无此配件（D7）。
8个窑位：高温区3、中温区3、低温区2。按人数盖住部分窑位（停用）：4人不盖（3-3-2）；3人盖1高1中（2-2-2）；2人盖1高2中1低（2-1-1）。2–3人另盖州衙第二工位。
任一状态下的器型卡。规则正文统一用“器物”，不用“陶瓷件”。

components.en: Main Order card / Starting Order card

round_start_setters_mark.en: the start of the Work Phase

firingSteps.note: 新名（旧“回合开始”）。掷窑骰；第2–5轮轮换委托榜；重置“每轮一次”。
新名（旧“作业阶段”）。不得停派，直到每人4名工人全部派出。
新名（旧“委托阶段”）。按起始玩家顺序单轮完成在手委托。“交货”只用于此阶段名。
新名（旧“整理阶段”）。收回工人与标记；削减委托至上限；传起始玩家标。
控火者暗选压火／守火／添柴，有柴簿者可加柴。
同时亮牌，然后支付全部柴。
窑骰点数 + 控火修正，限定0–5。
按起始玩家顺序；窑工标于此放置。
共窑：全窑火候 + 温区修正（或窑具修正）+ 火标。御窑：窑骰点数 + 窑火修正 + 御窑修正 + 火标。
匣钵护烧、复烧、哥窑开片等，按起始玩家顺序，各人自定己方顺序。
成器移入成器区；清空共窑与御窑；收回火标、窑工标、支烧窑具；窑火牌正面弃置；收回控火牌。与游戏名呼应。
共窑与所有御窑皆空时，不翻窑火牌。

firingTerms.note: 不称“封”。停用窑位不算空位，也不可使用。
沿用。= 窑骰点数 + 控火修正之和，限定0–5。
沿用。= 基础火候 + 窑火修正，不设上下限。
新名（旧“师傅火候标记”）。两面+1／−1；暗置后在火标步骤翻定或收回。
装入御窑时公开选定并记录（R10、R11）。
御窑器物由宫中窑匠代烧，不受控火影响。见 4.8。

firingTerms.en: Fire card / Fire deck / Fire discard pile
firingTerms.note: 弃牌堆正面朝上、公开；牌堆用尽时才洗混。
firingTerms.zh: 窑火牌／窑火牌堆／窑火弃牌堆

firingTerms.note: 须在共窑中至少有1件器物；御窑器物不算。
选压火或添柴时随控火牌暗附1柴，与控火牌同时亮出；修正改为压火−2或添柴+2，共付2柴。不是另一张控火牌。
弃1件本次烧成中仍为瑕品的器物，得2铜钱。

firingTerms.zh: 本次烧成；一窑（短提示可写“本窑”）

ability.en: Once per round, when resolving a Form & Decorate action, after you form a Bowl, Plate or Brush Washer, you may pay 1 Clay and 1 Coin to form and decorate one additional vessel of the same Shape. Its Decoration, whichever you choose, costs that 1 Coin. This additional vessel does not count against the action's vessel limit and is not one of the 2 vessels for the Shifu's Decoration discount. For effects that refer to vessels formed by that action, it counts as formed by that action.
ability.zh: 每轮一次，在结算制坯饰纹行动时，你制成1件碗、盘或笔洗后，可支付1泥和1铜钱，再制1件同器型的坯，并任选1种纹饰；该纹饰费用即为这1铜钱。学徒或师傅行动皆可。此额外坯不计入该行动的件数上限，也不是师傅纹饰减免所指的“2件”之一；对提及“该行动所制坯”的效果，视为该行动所制。师傅减免与饰坯匣都不适用于此件；它也不是瓶或香炉。练泥所制坯不触发定窑。

shortText.en:
Once per round, in a Form & Decorate action:
after forming a Bowl/Plate/Brush Washer, you may pay 1 Clay + 1 Coin for 1 more of that Shape
shortText.zh:
每轮一次，制坯饰纹行动中：
制碗／盘／笔洗后，可付1泥1铜钱再制1件同型坯

ability.en: Once per round, after Quality is assigned, choose 1 of your ceramics from this firing that is Standard: it develops Crackle and becomes Fine. Place a Crackle marker on it; the ceramic keeps the marker. When completing an Order, each of your Crackle ceramics may count as having any one Decoration for that Order's Decoration requirements. Its printed Decoration is unchanged. A Crackle ceramic is never a Masterpiece, so it cannot fill a Masterpiece requirement.
ability.zh: 每轮一次，定品后，你可以选择你本次烧成中1件当时为良品的器物：其开片，品质变为上品。在其上放置开片标；开片标保留至该器物交付或陈列。不使用时不消耗本轮次数。完成委托时，你的每件开片器可视为具有任意一种纹饰，以满足该委托的纹饰要求（每件各自声明）；其原纹饰不变，陈列与汝窑仍按原纹饰。开片器永不是臻品，不能满足臻品要求。可在匣钵护烧之后作用于同一器物（瑕品→良品→上品）。与其他“定品后”能力的顺序由你自定，不必最后结算。

shortText.en:
Once per round, after Quality: you may crackle 1 of your Standard ceramics from this firing to Fine
Completing Orders, Crackle counts as any one Decoration; never a Masterpiece
shortText.zh:
每轮一次，定品后：可令己方本窑1件良品开片升上品
完成委托时，开片器可作任一纹饰；永非臻品

ability.en: Once per round, when you complete an Order showing at least 1 Crown, gain 2 Coins and 1 VP.
ability.zh: 每轮一次，当你完成一张印有至少1个御令的委托时，获得2铜钱和1分。经漕船完成亦可触发；贡瓷额外获得的御令不算“印有”。

shortText.en: Once per round, completing an Order with 👑: gain 2 Coins and 1 VP
shortText.zh: 每轮一次，完成带👑委托时：得2铜钱1分

ability.en: Once per round, after Actual Heat is calculated but before Quality is assigned, you may pay 1 Wood to adjust the Actual Heat of one of your ceramics by +1 or −1.
ability.zh: 每轮一次，实际火候算出后、定品前，你可以支付1柴，将你1件器物的实际火候调整+1或−1（火标已计入）。（若本轮尚未使用，也可在复烧重算实际火候后、定新品质前用于该器物；已用过则不可再用。）

shortText.en: Once per round, before Quality: you may pay 1 Wood to adjust 1 of your ceramics' Actual Heat ±1
shortText.zh: 每轮一次，定品前：可付1柴，己方1件器物火候±1

ability.en: Once per round, when you complete an Order using a Masterpiece with Celadon Glaze and Plain Decoration, gain 4 VP. The Order itself does not need to require Masterpiece, Celadon or Plain; the delivered ceramic must actually have those attributes.
ability.zh: 每轮一次，当你完成委托时，若所交付器物中有1件为臻品、青釉、素面，获得4分。委托本身不必要求臻品、青釉或素面；只看实际交付器物的属性（开片器按原纹饰计）。经漕船完成亦可触发。

shortText.en: Once per round: complete an Order with a Celadon, Plain Masterpiece for +4 VP
shortText.zh: 每轮一次：以臻品青釉素面器完成委托，+4分

apprenticeText.en: Reserve 1 Main Order. Then gain 1 Clay, 1 Wood or 1 Coin.
apprenticeText.zh: 承接1张主委托，然后获得1泥、1柴或1铜钱。

shifuText.en: Reserve up to 2 Main Orders, resolving each reservation separately. For 1 of them you may instead look at the top 3 Main Orders, reserve 1 of them and discard the rest. After each Order you reserve, gain 1 Clay, 1 Wood or 1 Coin.
shifuText.zh: 承接1或2张主委托，逐次结算。其中1次可改为：私下查看主委托牌堆顶3张，承接1张，其余弃置。每承接1张后，获得1泥、1柴或1铜钱。

apprenticeText.en: Form 1 vessel: pay its Clay cost, choose a Decoration and pay the Decoration cost.
apprenticeText.zh: 制1件坯：支付其泥费用，选择1种纹饰并支付纹饰费用（2铜钱）。

shifuText.en: Form up to 2 vessels, choosing and paying a Decoration for each. If you form 2, one of their Decorations costs 1 Coin less.
shifuText.zh: 制1或2件坯，每件各选纹饰并付费。若制2件，其中1项纹饰少付1铜钱。

apprenticeText.en: Choose 1 of your Shaped vessels, give it a Glaze and load it.
apprenticeText.zh: 选择你的1件坯，为其选釉并装窑。

shifuText.en: Do this for up to 2 of your Shaped vessels. Then place your Heat marker face-down on 1 of your ceramics in the Shared Kiln or your Imperial Kiln. The Shifu stays on the Glaze & Load space.
shifuText.zh: 为你的1或2件坯施釉并装窑。然后你可以将火标暗置于你在共窑或御窑中1件未带火标的器物上（含本轮先前装入或经御烧优先装入者）。师傅留在此工位。

apprenticeText.en: Pay the printed Coin cost and take 1 face-up Advanced Tech.
apprenticeText.zh: 支付牌面铜钱费用，习得1张公开技艺。

shifuText.en: Choose 1 discipline and look at the top 2 Techs of that deck, or as many as remain. Then take either 1 face-up Advanced Tech from any discipline or 1 of the revealed Techs, paying 1 Coin less, minimum 0. Put any revealed Tech not taken on the bottom of its deck.
shifuText.zh: 选择1个门类，私下查看该牌堆顶2张（不足则看余数）。然后习得任一门类的1张公开技艺或所看的1张，少付1铜钱，最低为0。未取的所看技艺按你自定的顺序（保密）置于该牌堆底。

apprenticeText.en: Pay 4 Coins to advance your Imperial Recognition by 1 step.
apprenticeText.zh: 支付4铜钱，御府声望推进1格，并照常获得所到格的奖励。

shifuText.en: Pay 3 Coins to advance your Imperial Recognition by 1 step.
shifuText.zh: 支付3铜钱，御府声望推进1格，并照常获得所到格的奖励。

apprenticeText.en: Gain 3 resources in any combination of Clay and Wood.
apprenticeText.zh: 获得共3份泥和柴，任意组合。

shifuText.en: Gain 4 resources in any combination of Clay and Wood. Then you may pay 1 Coin to gain +1 Clay and +1 Wood.
shifuText.zh: 获得共4份泥和柴，任意组合。然后可支付1铜钱，额外获得1泥和1柴。

orderTerms.note: 无御令；弃置时放回盒中。
新名（旧“商业委托”），更有市井气息。不印御令。

orderTerms.note: 新名（旧“公开展示区”）。最左最旧，最右最新。
不看牌面，承接牌堆顶1张；委托榜不动。
查看牌堆顶3张，承接1张，其余弃置（私密）。
4张（有色样簿则5张），仅在收工时检查。
只能完成在手委托；榜上委托不能完成。所用器物随之“交付”。
除非卡面直接写明配对。
被承接的榜位留空至承接者回合结束，再左移补榜。
弃最左2张，余4张左移，翻2张补至6张。

requirements.zh: 盘 + 瓶 + 香炉；青釉、灰青釉、月白釉各1件；刻花、印花、画花各1件

requirements.zh: 3种不同器型；3种不同釉；3种不同纹饰

requirements.zh: 笔洗 + 瓶 + 香炉；白釉、灰青釉、月白釉各1件；至少2种不同纹饰

requirements.zh: 碗 · 任意釉 · 任意纹饰

requirements.zh: 笔洗 · 任意釉 · 任意纹饰

requirements.zh: 瓶 · 任意釉 · 任意纹饰

requirements.zh: 香炉 · 任意釉 · 任意纹饰

requirements.zh: 任意器型 · 青釉 · 任意纹饰

requirements.zh: 任意器型 · 灰青釉 · 任意纹饰

requirements.zh: 任意器型 · 月白釉 · 任意纹饰

requirements.zh: 任意器型 · 任意釉 · 素面

requirements.zh: 碗、盘或笔洗 · 任意釉 · 任意纹饰

requirements.zh: 任意器型 · 任意釉 · 任意纹饰

rewardText.en: Gain your Imperial Kiln tile: a private space fired by the court at the Kiln Die result + Fire + a modifier you choose when loading, immune to Contributions.
rewardText.zh: 获得御窑板块，放入你的御窑区：私人单格窑，由御匠代烧，实际火候 = 窑骰点数 + 窑火修正 + 装窑时自选的御窑修正 + 火标，不受控火影响。

rewardText.en: Take your coloured Imperial Priority token. Once per game, before or after your worker action, spend it to give 1 of your Shaped vessels a Glaze and load it into your empty Imperial Kiln.
rewardText.zh: 从声望轨第3格取回你颜色的御烧优先标。每局一次，在你的工人行动之前或之后，你可以交出此标，为你的1件坯施釉并装入你空置的御窑。

rewardText.en: Gain 6 VP. After this, each further Crown scores 1 VP immediately.
rewardText.zh: 获得6分。此后每获得1个御令，立即得1分。

summary.en: Roll the Kiln Die for this round's starting Base Heat; rotate Orders; refill displays; ready abilities.
summary.zh: 掷窑骰，定本轮基础火候起点；第2–5轮轮换委托榜；补齐委托榜与技艺；重置“每轮一次”能力。

summary.en: Alternate worker placements at central and personal locations.
summary.zh: 按起始玩家顺序轮流派工至中央地点与坊内地点，不得停派，直到每人4名工人全部派出。

summary.en: Contributions → Base Heat → Test Pieces → Heat markers → Fire → Actual Heat → Quality.
summary.zh: 控火 → 基础火候 → 火照 → 翻火标 → 翻窑火 → 实际火候 → 定品。

summary.en: Complete held Orders, one at a time, in turn order.
summary.zh: 按起始玩家顺序，逐张完成在手委托。

summary.en: Return workers and markers; trim Order hands; pass First Player.
summary.zh: 收回工人与标记；削减委托至上限；传起始玩家标。

ABILITY_ALREADY_USED.en: {kilnId} has already been used this round.

CERAMIC_NOT_FOUND.en: That ceramic does not exist or is not yours.
CERAMIC_NOT_FOUND.zh: 找不到这件器物，或它不属于你

CERAMIC_NOT_OWNED.en: That ceramic does not exist or is not yours.
CERAMIC_NOT_OWNED.zh: 找不到这件器物，或它不属于你

CONTRIBUTION_ALREADY_SUBMITTED.en: You have already submitted your Contribution; waiting for the other workshops.
CONTRIBUTION_ALREADY_SUBMITTED.zh: 你已提交控火，等候其他作坊

DUPLICATE_CERAMIC.en: The same ceramic cannot be chosen twice.
DUPLICATE_CERAMIC.zh: 同一件器物不能重复选用

HAND_LIMIT_DISCARD_COUNT.en: At Cleanup, discard down to {limit} Orders: discard {needed} more.
HAND_LIMIT_DISCARD_COUNT.zh: 收工须弃至{limit}张委托：请再弃{needed}张

HEAT_MARKER_INVALID.en: A ceramic may carry at most 1 Heat marker.
HEAT_MARKER_INVALID.zh: 一件器物至多带1个火标

ILLEGAL_CERAMIC_STAGE.en: That ceramic is {stage} now and cannot be used this way.
ILLEGAL_CERAMIC_STAGE.zh: 这件器物现在是{stage}，不能这样使用

IMPERIAL_KILN_UNAVAILABLE.en: You have no Imperial Kiln, or it already holds a ceramic this firing.
IMPERIAL_KILN_UNAVAILABLE.zh: 你尚无御窑，或御窑本次烧成已有器物

IMPERIAL_PRIORITY_UNAVAILABLE.en: You have no Imperial Priority token, your Imperial Kiln is not empty, or you have no Shaped vessel.
IMPERIAL_PRIORITY_UNAVAILABLE.zh: 你没有御烧优先标，或御窑不空，或没有坯

INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES.en: Not enough {resource}: you need {needed} and have {have}.

INVALID_BOTTOM_ORDER.en: Put every untaken inspected Tech on the bottom exactly once, in the order you choose.
INVALID_BOTTOM_ORDER.zh: 请为每张未取的技艺牌排定置底顺序

INVALID_CRACKLE_DECLARATION.en: That Crackle declaration is not valid: {reason}.

INVALID_RESOURCE_SPLIT.en: That split is not allowed: gain exactly {total} Clay and Wood in total.
INVALID_RESOURCE_SPLIT.zh: 资源分配不符：须恰好获得共{total}份泥和柴

INVALID_SETUP.en: This game cannot be set up: {reason}.

INVALID_VESSEL_CHOICE.en: That Shape or Decoration choice is not allowed.
INVALID_VESSEL_CHOICE.zh: 此器型或纹饰选择不可用

INVERTED_FIRING_INVALID.en: Inverted Firing stacks only a Bowl, Plate or Brush Washer in an active space holding exactly 1 of your ceramics.
INVERTED_FIRING_INVALID.zh: 覆烧只能将碗、盘或笔洗叠入恰有1件你的器物的启用窑位

KILN_SPACE_MARKED.en: {ownerId}'s Setter's Mark holds this space this round.
KILN_SPACE_MARKED.zh: 此窑位本轮已由{ownerId}的窑位签占用

KILN_SPACE_UNAVAILABLE.en: {spaceId} is not available: it is covered or already holds a ceramic.

KILN_UNAVAILABLE.en: That Kiln has already been chosen.

NOT_CONTRIBUTOR.en: You have no ceramic in the Shared Kiln, so you do not contribute this round.
NOT_CONTRIBUTOR.zh: 你在共窑中没有器物，本轮不参与控火

NOT_SHIFU_EFFECT.en: Only the Shifu effect allows that.
NOT_SHIFU_EFFECT.zh: 只有师傅效果可以这样做

NOT_YOUR_DECISION.en: It is not your turn yet; waiting for {waitingFor}.

NO_MAIN_ACTION_POSSIBLE.en: You cannot perform at least 1 instance of the main action at {locationId}, so you cannot place a worker there.
NO_MAIN_ACTION_POSSIBLE.zh: 你无法在{locationId}执行至少1次主行动，不能派工

ORDER_NOT_AVAILABLE.en: That Order is no longer on the display.
ORDER_NOT_AVAILABLE.zh: 这张委托已不在委托榜上

ORDER_NOT_HELD.en: You can complete only Orders in your hand.

ORDER_REQUIREMENTS_NOT_MET.en: The chosen ceramics do not meet Order {orderId}: {reason}.
ORDER_REQUIREMENTS_NOT_MET.zh: 所选器物不满足委托{orderId}的要求：{reason}

ORDER_SUPPLY_EMPTY.en: The Main Order deck and discard pile are both empty; there is nothing to reserve.
ORDER_SUPPLY_EMPTY.zh: 主委托牌堆与弃牌堆皆空，无可承接

PERSONAL_SPACE_LOCKED.en: Learn a {discipline} Tech to add this space.

PERSONAL_SPACE_USED.en: This space has already been used this round.

PRIVATE_WINDOW_MISMATCH.en: That Contribution window has closed or changed; please submit again.
PRIVATE_WINDOW_MISMATCH.zh: 此控火时机已结束或已更新，请重新提交

RECOGNITION_GATE.en: The Magistrate's Hall is usable only at Recognition 0–2 and never advances you to 4.
RECOGNITION_GATE.zh: 州衙只能在声望0–2时使用，不能推进至4

RESERVATION_LIMIT.en: This action has already reserved {limit} Orders.

SENIOR_APPRENTICE_NOT_APPLICABLE.en: Senior Apprentice applies only to an Apprentice at the Materials Yard or Commission Market.
SENIOR_APPRENTICE_NOT_APPLICABLE.zh: 高徒只适用于泥柴场或瓷牙行的学徒

STALE_CHOICE.en: The game has moved on; please choose again.
STALE_CHOICE.zh: 局面已更新，请重新选择

TECH_ALREADY_USED.en: {techId} has already been used this round.

TECH_NOT_AVAILABLE.en: That Tech is not available to take.
TECH_NOT_AVAILABLE.zh: 这张技艺牌不在可取之列

TOO_MANY_VESSELS.en: This action allows at most {limit} vessels.

UNKNOWN_PLAYER.en: That player is not seated in this game.

WORKER_ACTION_ALREADY_TAKEN.en: You have already placed a worker this turn.

WORKER_ACTION_REQUIRED.en: You may not pass in the Work Phase: place 1 worker (the Canal Wharf is always available).
WORKER_ACTION_REQUIRED.zh: 派工阶段不得停派，请派1名工人（漕运码头永远可派）

WRONG_PHASE.en: It is not {expectedPhase} now, so you cannot do that.

scoring.note: 沿用。数量不限，自动陈列所有良品以上未交付成器。
陈列中至少3种不同器型（共5种）。
陈列中至少3种不同釉（共4种）。
每习得1项技艺，立即得1分（A1）；终局不再另计，计分时单列一行。

ability.en: Once per round, during a Form & Decorate action in which you form at least 1 Vase or Censer, reduce that action's total Clay cost by 2, to a minimum of 0.
ability.zh: 每轮一次，在一次制坯饰纹行动中，若你至少制成1件瓶或香炉，该行动的泥总费用减少2，最低为0。（只减泥，不减纹饰费；练泥所制坯不在制坯饰纹行动中；定窑额外坯不是瓶或香炉。）

shortText.en: Once per round, Form & Decorate with a Vase/Censer: total Clay −2
shortText.zh: 每轮一次，制坯饰纹行动含瓶／香炉时：泥总费−2

ability.en: Once per round, when you glaze and load a Shaped vessel, you may first change its Shape to any other Shape: return its Vessel card and take the new one. No Clay is paid; its Decoration stays.
ability.zh: 每轮一次，每当你为1件坯施釉入窑时，可先将其器型改为任意其他器型：退回原器型卡，换取新器型卡。不付泥，纹饰不变。

shortText.en: Once per round, glazing and loading a vessel: you may first change its Shape, no Clay
shortText.zh: 每轮一次，坯施釉入窑前：可改器型，不付泥

ability.en: When acquired: look at the top 3 Main Orders, reserve 1 of them and discard the rest. This is not a Commission Market action and gives no resource. Ongoing: your Order hand limit is 5.
ability.zh: 习得时：私下查看主委托牌堆顶3张（不足则看余数），须承接其中1张，其余弃置。此为技艺效果，不算瓷牙行行动，不获得资源，只取自牌堆，委托榜不动。持续：你的委托上限为5张（每次收工均适用）。（只要至少能看1张，承接为强制。所看内容仅你可见；弃置之牌面朝下进入弃牌堆。）

shortText.en: When acquired: look at the top 3 Main Orders, reserve 1; hand limit 5
shortText.zh: 习得时：看主委托顶3张，须承接1张；委托上限5

ability.en: Once per round, after Quality is assigned, spend 1 Wood to improve the Quality of 1 of your Flawed or Standard ceramics from this firing by one level: Flawed → Standard or Standard → Fine. This cannot create a Masterpiece.
ability.zh: 每轮一次，定品后，你可以支付1柴，将你本次烧成中（共窑或御窑）的1件瑕品或良品提升一级：瑕品→良品，或良品→上品。不能由此成为臻品。不能作用于先前各轮烧成的器物。

shortText.en:
Once per round, after Quality: you may pay 1 Wood
1 of your ceramics from this firing: Flawed → Standard or Standard → Fine
shortText.zh:
每轮一次，定品后：可付1柴
己方本窑1件瑕品→良品或良品→上品

ability.en: When choosing Bank or Stoke, you may secretly commit 1 additional Wood with your Contribution card. Reveal them together. If you do, your Contribution becomes −2 or +2.
ability.zh: 选控火时，若你选择压火或添柴，可随控火牌暗附1柴，与控火牌同时亮出。若如此做，你的控火修正改为−2（压火）或+2（添柴），共付2柴。

shortText.en: With Bank or Stoke you may secretly add 1 Wood: the Contribution becomes −2/+2
shortText.zh: 压火／添柴时可暗加1柴，修正改为−2／+2

ability.en: Once per round, after Base Heat is determined and before Heat markers are set, if you have at least 1 ceramic in this firing, pay 1 Wood to privately look at the top Fire card. You may then put it on the bottom of the deck. You may not show it.
ability.zh: 每轮一次，基础火候定后、翻火标前，若你有至少1件器物在本次烧成中（含御窑），可支付1柴，私下查看窑火牌堆顶1张。然后你可以将其置于牌堆底。不得展示该牌，但可以谈论所见。（按起始玩家顺序结算；付柴与置底为公开信息，所见点数仅你可见。）

shortText.en:
Once per round, after Base Heat: you may pay 1 Wood to peek at the top Fire card
You may then put it on the bottom
shortText.zh:
每轮一次，基础火候定后：可付1柴私看顶牌
看后可将其置于牌堆底

ability.en: Once per round, after Quality is assigned, choose 1 of your Flawed or Standard ceramics from this firing. Reveal 1 extra Fire card and recalculate that ceramic's Actual Heat and Quality with the same Base Heat, zone modifier, Kiln Furniture modifier and Heat marker and the new Fire modifier. Jun's adjustment from the first calculation does not carry over. The new Quality replaces the old, even if worse. Discard the extra Fire card after resolving it.
ability.zh: 每轮一次，定品后，你可以选择你本次烧成中的1件瑕品或良品，额外翻1张窑火牌，以相同的基础火候、温区修正、窑具修正与火标配合新的窑火修正，重新计算该器物的实际火候与品质。首次计算时的钧窑调整不保留。新品质取代旧品质，即使更差。结算后弃置这张额外窑火牌；它不影响其他器物。（若本轮尚未使用钧窑，可在重算实际火候后、定新品质前使用。）

shortText.en:
Once per round, after Quality: you may refire 1 of your Flawed/Standard ceramics from this firing
Reveal 1 extra Fire card; the new Quality stands even if worse
shortText.zh:
每轮一次，定品后：可令己方本窑1件瑕品／良品复烧
另翻1张窑火牌重算，结果更差也须接受

ability.en: Once per round, when you load 1 ceramic into the Shared Kiln, you may place this tile beneath it and choose its zone modifier for this firing: −1, 0 or +1. Return the tile after firing.
ability.zh: 每轮一次，当你将1件器物装入共窑时，可将本牌垫于其下，并为本次烧成选定该器物的温区修正：−1、0或+1。烧成后收回本牌。只用于共窑。

shortText.en:
Once per round, loading into the Shared Kiln: you may place this beneath 1 ceramic
Its zone modifier is your choice of −1/0/+1
shortText.zh:
每轮一次，装共窑时：可垫于1件之下
该件温区修正自选−1／0／+1

ability.en: Once per round, 1 Carved, Impressed or Painted Decoration you apply costs 1 Coin less. It may be the same Decoration the Shifu's discount reduces.
ability.zh: 每轮一次，你施加的1项刻花、印花或画花纹饰少付1铜钱。可与师傅的纹饰减免作用于同一纹饰（刻花即为0铜钱）。可用于经练泥所付的纹饰；不适用于素面，也不适用于定窑的1铜钱额外坯。

shortText.en: Once per round: 1 Carved/Impressed/Painted Decoration costs 1 Coin less
shortText.zh: 每轮一次：1项刻花／印花／画花少付1铜钱

ability.en: Once per round, during a Materials Yard action, after gaining resources, you may form 1 vessel: pay its Clay cost +1 and a Decoration cost. This is a Tech effect, not a Form & Decorate action.
ability.zh: 每轮一次，在一次泥柴场行动中获得资源后，你可以制1件坯：支付其泥费用+1，并选择1种纹饰支付纹饰费用。这是技艺效果，不算制坯饰纹行动。

shortText.en:
Once per round, Materials Yard action after gaining: you may form 1 vessel
Clay cost +1, pay its Decoration
shortText.zh:
每轮一次，泥柴场行动得料后：可制1件坯
泥费+1，纹饰照付

ability.en: Once per round, 1 Apprentice you place at the Materials Yard or Commission Market resolves the Shifu effect there instead of the Apprentice effect.
ability.zh: 每轮一次，你派往泥柴场或瓷牙行的1名学徒，可改为结算该地点的完整师傅效果：在泥柴场含“付1铜钱得1泥1柴”；在瓷牙行含至多2次承接、其中1次可看三取一、每次承接后得1份资源。不适用于州衙。不使用时，该学徒照常结算学徒效果，本轮仍可留待另一名学徒使用。

shortText.en: Once per round: 1 Apprentice at the Materials Yard or Commission Market may resolve the Shifu effect
shortText.zh: 每轮一次：泥柴场或瓷牙行可令1名学徒按师傅结算

ability.en: At game end, each Fine or Masterpiece ceramic in your Exhibition scores +1 VP, up to +5 VP.
ability.zh: 终局时，你的终局陈列中每件上品或臻品额外+1分，至多+5分。

shortText.en: Game end: +1 VP per Fine or Masterpiece in your Exhibition, max +5
shortText.zh: 终局：陈列中每件上品或臻品+1分，至多+5

ability.en: Once per round, after a Glaze & Load action in which you loaded at least 1 ceramic, gain 1 Clay and 1 Wood.
ability.zh: 每轮一次，在一次至少装窑1件的施釉装窑行动之后，获得1泥和1柴。（数字版于每轮首次符合条件时自动结算。经御烧优先或其他技艺效果装窑不触发。）

shortText.en: Once per round, after a Glaze & Load action that loads: gain 1 Clay and 1 Wood
shortText.zh: 每轮一次，施釉装窑行动装窑后：得1泥1柴

ability.en: Once per round, when you load a Bowl, Plate or Brush Washer into the Shared Kiln, you may place it in an active space that already holds exactly 1 of your ceramics. Both use that space's modifier (or its Kiln Furniture modifier).
ability.zh: 每轮一次，当你将1件碗、盘或笔洗装入共窑时，可将其放入一个恰有1件你的器物的启用窑位，包括本次行动先装入的那件。两件器物都使用该窑位的温区修正（若该窑位有支烧窑具，则用窑具修正）。只用于共窑。

shortText.en: Once per round: a Bowl/Plate/Brush Washer may stack in a space holding exactly 1 of your ceramics
shortText.zh: 每轮一次：碗／盘／笔洗可叠入己方仅1件的窑位

ability.en: Once per round, at the start of the Work Phase (in First Player order), place this tile on an empty active Shared Kiln space. Only you may load there this round. Return it when you load there, or at Cleanup.
ability.zh: 每轮一次，派工阶段开始时（按起始玩家顺序），你可以将本牌放在共窑一个空的启用窑位上。本轮只有你能在此装窑。你在此装窑时，或收工时，收回本牌。（本轮中途习得者，从下一次派工阶段开始时起放置。只用于共窑。）

shortText.en: Once per round, at the start of the Work Phase: you may mark 1 empty kiln space; only you may load there
shortText.zh: 每轮一次，派工阶段开始时：可占1空窑位，仅你可装

ability.en: Once per round, before or after one of your worker actions, you may complete 1 held Order, following every rule for completing Orders. This counts as completing an Order for Ru and Guan.
ability.zh: 每轮一次，在你的一次工人行动之前或之后，你可以完成1张在手委托，遵守完成委托的全部规则。此举在一切方面视为完成委托：触发汝窑、官窑与贡瓷，开片器亦可充作纹饰。这是技艺效果，不是工人行动。

shortText.en: Once per round, before or after a worker action: you may complete 1 held Order
shortText.zh: 每轮一次，工人行动前或后：可完成1张在手委托

ability.en: Once per round, in the Heat marker step, place the Kiln Master marker (+1 or −1 face up) on 1 of your ceramics in this firing that carries no Heat marker. It is a Heat marker for all rules.
ability.zh: 每轮一次，在火标步骤中，你可以将窑工标（+1或−1面朝上）放在你本次烧成中1件未带火标的器物上。在一切规则中视为火标。一件器物至多带1个火标；若你先收回了自己的火标，窑工标可放上那件器物。

shortText.en: Once per round, Heat marker step: you may place the ±1 Kiln Master marker on your ceramic without a marker
shortText.zh: 每轮一次，火标步骤：窑工标±1可放己方无火标器物

ability.en: Once per round, when you complete an Order showing at least 1 Crown, gain 1 additional Crown.
ability.zh: 每轮一次，当你完成一张印有至少1个御令的委托时，额外获得1个御令。（此御令推进御府声望，声望满4后计1分；但它不是印刷御令，不触发官窑，也不计入平局判定②。）

shortText.en: Once per round, completing an Order with 👑: gain 1 additional Crown
shortText.zh: 每轮一次，完成带👑委托时：额外得1个御令

uiVerbs.en: Skip (an optional step; never the Work Phase)
